limitations: Two exposed months do not establish a durable edge or an optimal live risk setting.
Only observed standalone source fills are available; rejected trades can create unobserved later signals.
Sampled equity is not tick maximum drawdown; guard slippage, request budgets, cooldown wallclock and full current-SL timeline are not reconstructed.
Recorded costs are native tester costs, not verified historical commission/financing schedules.
Snapshot spreads and margins are sensitivities/estimates, not historic realized execution or fixed future conditions.
Higher volumes are linear resizes of existing standalone fills; liquidity/commission tiers and unseen signals after rejected source trades are not reconstructed.
Five-minute sampled DD and admission stops do not guarantee the20%/10%loss limits against gaps or intrabar moves.
An end-censored position remains open; its entry fee is cash, final sampled floating is unrealized, and its artificial native liquidation is never booked.
Risk and drawdown limits are hypotheses, not a live recommendation or a pass-probability estimate.
As-packaged returns are NOT equal-risk rankings: Top5 and PropReady have materially different caps, rounding and percent bases.
If sampled capital exhaustion occurs, post-exhaustion history is not an executable account path. Margin level proxies are disclosed; broker stopout is not silently simulated.
Only current delivered Top5 Nasdaq has default DI changed; no PropReady or global production EA modification.
